details.reason: Withhold after independent risk audit (learner-critical-answer): The Indonesian answer and electrical-device sense are sound. Malaysian penyesuai is an official equivalent of adapter, but penyesuai perjalanan is not independently established as a common Malaysian collocation, and adapter/adaptor also remains usable. Therefore the card overstates a clean different-common-word contrast and should present the Malaysian form as a formal/standard alternative rather than a categorical regional distinction. Retain outside promotion pending a vetted correction and fresh current clearance.
